material.description: Design, from the user: every character name has a well-known acronym; show it in capitals behind the icon and drop the name under the icon. Rule (default, for the user to review): a multi-word name gives its word initials (Anti-Mage -> AM, Sand King -> SK, Queen of Pain -> QOP, Nature's Prophet -> NP, Crystal Maiden -> CM); a one-word name gives its first three letters (Axe -> AXE, Lina -> LIN); hyphens split words, apostrophes are dropped. Overrides: a heroAcronyms object in scenarios/moba/moba_ui.json maps a hero name to its acronym, and wins over the rule. The grid tile passes badge = the acronym and text = "" to the portraits item (widget contract in row portraits-badge-behind-icon: badge and text fields). The right hero card and the seat strip keep the name. Ownership: scenarios/moba/panels.lua and scenarios/moba/moba_ui.json. Depends on portraits-badge-behind-icon for the badge field; the lane may land first if the field name matches the contract. Acceptance: the grid tiles show the acronym and no name under the icon; CI green on the pushed sha.
